messages:
maria: Hey team — escalated ticket from Acme Corp. They hit a 500 on /v1/generate when sending a prompt that includes sensitive customer data. Customer expects repro steps + sanitized debug bundle. Request id = req_9a2f7c4e. Latency also spiky (~4s tail) but main ask is repro + PII scrub before sharing with eng.
kevin: @maria can you paste the minimal repro curl (with tokens redacted) and the exact timestamp + region? we need model + sequence length.
maria: timestamp 2026-02-21T18:42:11Z, region=us-west-2, model=redwood-instruct-v1. repro curl (token removed):
```
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-instruct-v1","input":"Customer complaint: payment failed for card 4111-XXXX-XXXX-1111, email alice@example.com, acct 987654321. Please advise."}'
```
maria: stack trace from request (scrubbed header tokens):
```
500 Internal Server Error
at inference_service.py:482 process_request()
  -> kv_cache.py line 119 KeyError 'cache_segment_12'
```
anil: thx. can you run our debug bundle collector with the request id and the time window around it? That gives logs, kernel traces, and the request payload. Command:
```
./tools/collect-debug-bundle --request-id req_9a2f7c4e --start 2026-02-21T18:40:00Z --end 2026-02-21T18:45:00Z --out ./debugs/req_9a2f7c4e.tar.gz
```
anil: note: that will include raw prompt content. do NOT upload raw to public storage. we need a sanitized copy for eng first.
julie: security checklist for sharing: 1) strip emails/phone numbers/account numbers 2) mask credit card PANs (keep BIN/last4 only) 3) remove auth tokens and IPs 4) replace any full names with <REDACTED_NAME> 5) add a scrub manifest listing applied regexes. Use our scrub tool or the inline sed if quick.
maria: ran the collector and have bundle at ./debugs/req_9a2f7c4e.tar.gz. will scrub now.
julie: recommended quick redaction steps (POSIX):
```
# mask emails
sed -E 's/([A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+)@([A-Za-z0-9.-]+)"?/\/<REDACTED_EMAIL>"/g' < input.json > tmp && mv tmp input.json
# mask cc (keep last4)
sed -E 's/(\b[0-9]{4})[- ]?[0-9]{4}[- ]?[0-9]{4}[- ]?([0-9]{4}\b)/****-****-****-\2/g' < input.json > tmp && mv tmp input.json
```
julie: or use our python scrubper for full bundle (preferred):
```
python tools/scrubper.py --in ./debugs/req_9a2f7c4e.tar.gz \
  --rules tools/scrub_rules.yaml \
  --out ./debugs/req_9a2f7c4e_sanitized.tar.gz
```
julie: scrub_rules.yaml should contain the standard patterns (email, cc, ssn, ip, bearer-token). I pushed the canonical rules to gs://redwood-internal/scrub-rules/2026-02-01.yaml
maria: ran scrubper, produced sanitized bundle. quick sanity diff showed emails and cc masked. preserved non-sensitive context for repro.
kevin: please attach the sanitized bundle here and include a 1-2 line repro: exact curl (with <REDACTED> tokens), model, sequence length, and whether you hit 500 reproducibly.
maria: uploaded sanitized bundle to internal support share: s3://support-scrubbed/req_9a2f7c4e_sanitized.tar.gz (ACL=team-support). Repro steps: run the curl above (with model redwood-instruct-v1) — failure reproducible on our staging account at ~30% attempts, 500 after token 250. Added notes in README inside bundle.
kevin: ENG: I pulled bundle. anil can you attach kernel logs and the kv cache dump to the ticket? looks like KeyError in cache segment — maybe cache eviction bug with long input.
anil: grabbing kv cache dump now. FYI I ran a quick grep on sanitized payloads to confirm no email/cc slipped through: `grep -E "[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+" -R ./unpacked || echo clean` -> returned clean.
debug-bot: debug-bundle created: req_9a2f7c4e_sanitized.tar.gz by maria at 2026-02-21T19:03:22Z :lock:
kevin: good. once eng triages please update ticket with root cause and whether we need a hotfix. ops note: if it's a cache segfault we may need a rollback for the recent cache allocator change (deployed 2026-02-20).
maria: customer updated: they need ETA and whether we share sanitized bundle with their security team. Julie, is it okay to share sanitized bundle externally?
julie: yes, sanitized bundle meets our external-share policy if scrubper exit code = 0 and manifest included. always prefer SFTP or customer-managed S3 with encryption. mark the ticket with "sanitized_shared_with_customer" and include scrub manifest.
maria: done. I'll follow up with customer and attach manifest + short repro note. thanks all :thumbsup:
kevin: filing a follow-up eng ticket to look at eviction logic. tagging @anil for triage. :eyes:
